remarks:
Flexible C-1 Zoned Property with Residential & Commercial Potential!

Discover an exceptional opportunity to live, work, and grow all in one location. Situated on an acre, this unique property offers C-1 zoning, providing flexibility for both residential and commercial use. The refurbished and remodeled three-bedroom, two-bath home offers comfortable living space, while the additional commercial space provides an ideal opportunity for a business, professional office, studio, or other permitted use.

A welcoming enclosed porch provides a charming space and conveniently connects both the residential and commercial spaces. The commercial space was remodeled in 2024 and features a half bath, mini-split heating and cooling, and an upgraded electrical panel, making it ready for a variety of uses.

The property has seen an impressive list of recent improvements, including new siding (2025), some replacement windows (2024), upgraded insulation (2024), carpeting (2024), a new deck (2024), and updated landscaping (2026). Additional exterior improvements include new sidewalks in 2024 and 2026, a top-dressed driveway (2026), and a new garage roof and garage doors (2026).

An oversized 2½-car garage provides excellent storage and parking, while the private backyard offers plenty of room to relax or entertain. For those looking to expand the commercial potential, there is the possibility of replacing the existing garage with up to a 3,000-square-foot commercial/accessory building, subject to applicable zoning, permitting, and approvals.

Whether you’re looking for a home with space for your business, an investment opportunity, or a property that can adapt to your changing needs, this versatile offering combines residential comfort, commercial functionality, good visibility, recent improvements, a private one-acre setting, and significant future potential.
